description: Returns live Lingard cards in a collection that are missing requested fields such as translation, POS, pronunciation, examples, or image. A curated Lingard collection always reports zero gaps: its words come from the Lingard catalog and are not the user's to fill.

collectionTitle.description: Collection selector (alternative to `collectionUuid`): the collection title.

collectionUuid.description: Collection selector: its UUID. One of `collectionUuid` or `collectionTitle` is required (UUID wins if both are given).

fields.description: Optional. An ARRAY of field-name strings, not a bare string: e.g. ["translation"] for one field or ["translation","image"] for several. Returns cards missing ANY listed field; without it every field is checked.

name: lingard_get_collection_gaps
title: Get Lingard Collection Gaps
